name: Layout Builder Browser Block Library
description: Adds access to global block library on all inline blocks.
project_description: This module provides a 'Browse Block Library' link next to 'Inline Blocks' available in Layout Builder Browser . For example, if you have a 'Banner' block in layout builder browser, you can choose to either create a new 'Banner', or to select an existing Banner from your block library. Layout Builder Browser is built as a curated and categorized block list for editors to choose from, so this provides a means of accessing dynamically created blocks as a sub option to the curated inline form.
